notes.text: The page asks for a combinatorial realization of the groupoid S TD_top^± and its graph-valued functor. It then adds a chosen subset R′ of marked points and asks to describe the gommage functor and its compatibility diagram. This is a programme stated on the page, not a construction proved here.

The lower diagram distinguishes forgetting the choice of R′ from erasing the marked points themselves. Two oblique arrows meet at the weighted-graph target; the further right target remembers gamma weighting but not r weighting. The cancellation of bi and the overwritten labels are preserved rather than silently repaired.

The marginal note contrasts erasing all repères on a component with the other case, then states that the relevant operations are inverse and give equivalences of groupoids. It asks to separate essential erasures, which change the automorphism group, from the others. Several words between the strengthening clause and this conclusion remain unreadable as complete letter sequences; no theorem is inferred from those doubtful words.

C duplicates and misorders the marginal strengthening clause. The ink has one live plutôt dans le sens d’un renforcement de structure sequence; qu’il s’agit, a second renforcement, and des nouvelles données are not separately written. The long raised l’opération de gommage et celles is associated with the crossed line before de surmarquage.

The marginal run before R′_C is retained at low confidence. Its final de is more legible than its middle. After the formula the visible words are dans le cas, followed by catégories isotopiques; no syntactically expected connecting words have been supplied from the mathematics.

The final main sentence stops at alors qu’au niveau. The top handwritten 9 and lower handwritten 52 are both transcribed. The image is an upright handwritten sheet; the long marginal note is oblique and overlaps the main text.

The original and each prepared half were read once for the primary pass, including shared witness readings. The line count includes physical text/formula/diagram-label rows and both handwritten folios. Additional views were confined to evidence crops; no OCR, external source, or TeX compilation was used.

The main reader consolidated duplicate audit rectangles and combined their complete target readings. The long margin is covered by successive overlapping units; repeated boxes for identical ink were removed without removing any required category of target. Resolving C’s leading reading without changing its words is recorded in decisions rather than counted as a material change against C.
